description: This Java class, GlobalConfigurationValidationService, is responsible for validating global configuration names for tenants in the Fineract platform. It implements initialization logic to verify that configuration names conform to a specific pattern and throws exceptions if violations are detected.

classes.name: GlobalConfigurationValidationService
classes.description: Service responsible for validating the naming pattern of global configurations for each tenant during initialization.

methods.name: afterPropertiesSet
methods.description: Initializes the service and triggers validation of global configuration names after bean properties are set.

methods.name: validateGlobalConfigurationNames
methods.description: Retrieves all tenants and validates their global configuration names.

methods.name: validateGlobalConfigurationForIndividualTenant
methods.description: Validates each global configuration name for a specific tenant, ensuring it matches the required pattern.

methods.name: getGlobalConfigurationNames
methods.description: Queries the database to retrieve all configuration names for a particular tenant.
